[Updates]

  • Health increased from 2245 to 2470
  • Health Regen increased from 4.68 to 5.15
  Talents:
  Level 7:
  • Warp Sickness (E)
    • Slow amount increased from 30 to 35%

=== Heroes: Brightwing ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Soothing Mist (Trait)
    • Heal amount decreased from 120 to 115
  Talents:
  Level 1:
  • Unfurling Spray (Trait)
    • Range increase on Soothing Mist reduced from 33 to 20%
  Level 7:
  • Mistified (Trait)
    • Cooldown Reduction when casting abilities reduced from .75 to .5
  Level 13:
  • Shield Dust (E)
    • Ability damage reduction decreased from 50 to 40%

=== Heroes: Chromie ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Slowing Sands (R)
    • Mana cost reduced from 4 to 2 per second
    • Slow increased from 50% after 5 seconds, to 60% after 3 seconds
  Talents:
  • Level 7
    • Mobius Loop (W)
      • Cooldown and Mana cost reduction increased from 40% to 50%
    • Chrono Sickness (E)
      • Slow duration increased from 3 to 4 seconds
      • Now also reduces the Mana cost of Time Trap by 50%
  • Level 20
    • Pocket of Time (R)
      • Slow increased from 70% to 80%
    • Past and Future Me (Passive)
      • Damage reduced from 50% to 40%

=== Heroes: Falstad ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Mighty Gust (R)
    • Movement speed initial slow reduced from 60 to 40%
    • Movement speed decay time reduced from 5 to 4 seconds
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Gathering Storm (Q)
      • Damage per Hero hit reduced from 2 to 1.5

=== Heroes: Greymane ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Curse of the Worgen (Trait)
    • Worgen form Damage bonus decreased from 50 to 40%
  • Go for the Throat (R)
    • Range reduced by roughly 20%
  • Marked for the Kill (R)
    • Cooldown reduced from 50 to 40 seconds
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could cause opposing Greymanes to become stuck after simultaneously casting Darkflight on each other.
  • Will no longer become stuck if Darkflight is interrupted by Diablo's Shadow Charge or Stitches's Hook.

=== Heroes: Tyrael ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • It is no longer possible to deal damage with Basic Abilities while in Archangel's Wrath after choosing the Even in Death talent.
